notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Fain.
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional Zombie.
description:
Activate Fain's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Gravecrawler.
 Gravecrawler dies, triggering Fain, untapping it.
Resolve the Fain ability from step 1, putting two +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {B}.
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana and counters, you may instead activate Fain's other abilities.
